{{Infobox religious building|image=File:Aki-jinja, haisho-2.jpg|prefecture={{ill|Uda|qid=Q863747|1=Uda, Nara}}|coordinates={{Coord|34.47825|N|135.92397222222223}}}}

{{ill|Aki Shrine|ja|阿紀神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aki Shrine|qq=}} is a {{ill|Moto-Ise Shrines|lt=Motoise shrine|ja|元伊勢|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moto-Ise Shrines|qq=}} located in [[Yamato Province]] (modern [[Uda]], Nara). It is listed in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]].

Moto-Ise Shrines are {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} that used to host Amaterasu before she was moved to [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]]. The first one was {{ill|Hibara Shrine|ja|檜原神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hibara Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 大神神社|1=Ōmiwa Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q705542}} ({{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|en|Ōmiwa Shrine|qid=Q705542|lt=Ōmiwa Shrine|1=Ōmiwa Shrine}}).
